blocks.title: Structural biology
blocks.text: Structural biology macromolecules, jin mein proteins aur nucleic acids shamil hain, ki teen-jehti (three-dimensional, 3D) banawat (structures) ka atomi satah par mutala hai. Yeh kisi biomolecule ki banawat, us ke kaam (functions), us ki harkat (dynamics), aur ligands aur doosre macromolecules ke saath us ke taalluq (interaction) ki tafseeli maloomat deti hai.
Structural biology ke bohat se istemal (applications) hain, khaas kar tibbi (medical) research mein. Yahan chaar bayan kiye gaye hain.
1. Active sites aur domains maloom karna

Structural biologists proteins aur nucleic acids jaise macromolecules ki 3D banawat maloom kar sakte hain. Yeh banawat kisi macromolecule ke active sites aur mukhtalif domains, yani alag banawati ikaiyon (units) jin ke apne azaad kaam hain, ki theek jagah, shakal aur mahol zahir karti hai. Maslan enzyme HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke banawati mutalon ne us ka polymerase domain, jo DNA banata hai, aur us ka RNase H domain, jo RNA-DNA hybrids ka RNA strand torta hai, pehchane hain. In domains ki jagah aur banawat janne se aise antiviral dawaon ke design mein madad mili jo khaas taur par inhen nishana banati hain. Isi tarah serine proteases ki banawat ek wazeh active site zahir karti hai jo peptide bonds torne ka zimmedar hai.

Structural biology scientists ko beemari paida karne wale molecule par woh sahi jagah dhundne mein madad deti hai jahan dawa kaam kar sake. Yeh jagahein aam taur par proteins hain aur drug targets kehlati hain. In proteins ki 3D shakal parh kar scientists khaas jagahein dhundte hain jahan dawa jur kar protein ko kaam karne se rok sake. COVID-19 mein scientists ne structural biology se coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 ke spike protein ka mutala kiya, jo virus ko insani cells mein dakhil hone mein madad deta hai. Us ki 3D banawat jaan kar unhon ne use drug target ke taur par pehchana aur aisi vaccines aur dawaein design kin jo spike protein ko rokti hain, aur virus ko mazeed cells ko infect karne se rokti hain.

Structural biology yeh samajhne mein bhi madad deti hai ke pathogens (jaise viruses ya bacteria) host ke jism ke cells se kaise taalluq rakhte hain, yani host-pathogen interaction. Pathogen aur host cell dono ke proteins ki 3D banawat parh kar scientists dekh sakte hain ke pathogen host cell se kaise jurta aur us mein dakhil hota hai aur is amal mein kaun se molecules shamil hain. Structural biologists ne coronavirus ki satah se nikle spike protein ka aur insani cells par us protein ka mutala kiya jo spike ke receptor ka kaam karta hai, aur yun bilkul theek daryaft kiya ke virus insani cells mein kaise dakhil hota hai. Yeh maloomat aisi dawaein banane mein nihayat aham thi jo receptor proteins se jurti hain; aisi dawa virus ke receptor se taalluq ko rokti hai aur nateejatan host cells mein virus ka dakhla band kar deti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: ek enzyme do jure hue dhabbon ke taur par, peele active site wala sabz polymerase domain aur jamni RNase H domain. Daen: spike proteins wala gol virus ek insani cell ke saath jis mein receptor ka khancha hai; receptor ke samne ek surkh dawa baithi hai aur spike ka us tak rasta band hai.
blocks.caption: Enzyme ke domains, aur virus ke spike ko us ke receptor se rokne wali dawa (Figures 7.1 aur 7.2 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Domain macromolecule ki alag banawati ikai hai jis ka apna kaam hai: HIV-1 reverse transcriptase mein DNA banane wala polymerase domain aur RNA-DNA hybrids ka RNA strand torne wala RNase H domain hai, aur dawaein unhen nishana banane ke liye design hoti hain. SARS-CoV-2 ka spike protein insani cells par ek receptor protein se jurta hai; dono banawatein janne se pata chala ke virus kaise dakhil hota hai, aur spike ya receptor ko rokne wali dawaein ya vaccines infection rok deti hain. Shaklein khaaka (schematic) hain.

blocks.text: Protein ka kaam us ke teen-jehti shakal mein sahi fold hone par munhasir hai. Kai beemariyan, jin mein cystic fibrosis, Parkinson's aur Alzheimer's shamil hain, proteins ki ghalat folding se paida hoti hain. Structural biology pecheeda folding raston aur is baat ki samajh deti hai ke ghalat folding in beemariyon tak kaise le jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek jane-pehchane khandan ka naya virus saamne aata hai. Beemari rokne mein madad ke liye structural biologist chaar istemal kis tarteeb se karega?
blocks.explanation: Pehle virus ke satah ke protein ki 3D banawat maloom kar ke us ke domains aur active sites dhunde; phir pehchane ke in mein se drug target kaun sa hai; phir us insani receptor ki banawat hal kar ke jis se yeh jurta hai host-pathogen taalluq samjhe, taake dawaein ya vaccines dakhla rok saken; yahan ghalat folding ka mutala kam aham hai magar un host proteins par lagu hota hai jinhen virus kharab karta hai.

items: Structural biology proteins aur nucleic acids ki 3D banawat atomi satah par parhti hai, un ke kaam, harkat aur taalluqat ke saath.

Istemal: active sites aur domains ki jagah (HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, serine proteases); drug targets pehchanna (SARS-CoV-2 spike); host-pathogen taalluqat samajhna (spike aur receptor); protein ki ghalat folding ki beemariyan samjhana (cystic fibrosis, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's).
